_comment: Registry of the site's legal / policy documents. It drives the document
index in the legal pages' sidebar and the 'previous versions' link.
Adding a document is a pure data edit: append an entry here and add its
titleKey to both language blocks in src/js/i18n.js. Nothing in the layout
or the JavaScript needs to change — the sidebar groups by `group` and
marks the current page by matching `url` against the location.
archiveUrl points at the upstream file's commit history, which is the
actual version archive: the documents live in mbiX-hub and every revision
is public there, which is what the policies themselves promise.
